editorial.blurb: Honey Butter Fried Chicken serves up crispy, juicy fried chicken paired with their signature honey butter and irresistible cornbread in a lively, welcoming spot that has people coming back for more.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the cornbread or corn muffins and ask for the honey butter on the side—it's the perfect pairing, and the staff will happily bring takeout orders to your table. Lunch on a weekday afternoon is quieter if you prefer a calmer vibe.
